name: Rumi
source:
A dragon maiden maid. Ruler of Dungeon 5.

Dedicated to her duties with a strong sense of responsibility. When scolding Kissa, she gives her bottom a smack.

Her seriousness sometimes makes her lose sight of her surroundings. She has little immunity to lewd things and lacks knowledge about them.

[From [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid3/charactor02.html]Official website[/url]]
